title_zh: Agent Forge (FAF v2) vs. Microsoft AGENT-FORGE 机制契约与能力评测报告（7 页 4:5 视觉卡片版）
title_en: Agent Forge (FAF v2) vs. Microsoft AGENT-FORGE Contract & Capability Benchmark Report (7-Card 4:5 Visual Deck)

provenance.note: All percentages, weights, token accounting formulas, hook overhead measurements, and validation rules are extracted directly from pinned commit blobs (590 blobs in faf-agents, 38 blobs in microsoft/agent-forge).

scenarios.question_zh: FAF v2.0.1 插件市场 (`marketplace.json`) 是否将单包拆分为 `faf-core`、`faf-genai`、`faf-analytics` 三大独立插件？
scenarios.question_en: Does FAF v2.0.1 (`marketplace.json`) split the monolithic package into 3 modular plugins (`faf-core`, `faf-genai`, `faf-analytics`)?

scenarios.question_zh: `faf-genai@2.1.0` 是否完整提供从 Scoping 到 Delivery 的 6 个 GA 角色 Agent 与 9 个 `FAF-genai-*` 提示词命令？
scenarios.question_en: Does `faf-genai@2.1.0` provide all 6 GA role agents and 9 `FAF-genai-*` slash prompt commands from Scoping to Delivery?

scenarios.question_zh: Implementation Recommender 的 8 域加权评分卡权重总和是否严格等于 100% 且设置 `>70%` / `40-70%` / `<40%` 三档决策阈值？
scenarios.question_en: Do the 8 accelerator scoring area weights sum to 100% (25+20+18+15+10+5+4+3) with >70% / 40-70% / <40% thresholds?

scenarios.question_zh: `faf-ai-prioritization` 是否在三维度评分外实施 9 项门禁（2 项 Hard Gate + 7 项 Readiness Gate）与置信度底线（`<40%` Provisional）？
scenarios.question_en: Does `faf-ai-prioritization` enforce 9 gates (2 hard + 7 readiness) and a 40% confidence floor across Value, Feasibility, and Readiness?

scenarios.question_zh: `src/analytics/agents/` 目录下的 9 个 Analytics Agent 是否全部在 `src/analytics/plugin.json` 中默认注册暴露？
scenarios.question_en: Are all 9 agent files in `src/analytics/agents/` registered by default in `src/analytics/plugin.json`?

scenarios.question_zh: 在不开启 VS Code OTel (`dbSpanExporter`) 的默认 VS Code Chat Journal 路径下，能否获取完整嵌套子 Agent Token 与逐调用精确归因？
scenarios.question_en: Without VS Code OTel enabled, does the default VS Code Chat Journal provide full nested-subagent tokens and per-call attribution?

scenarios.category: FAF · VS Code Plugin Cache Update
scenarios.question_zh: 在 VS Code UI 中卸载 FAF 插件后直接重新添加，是否会自动拉取 GitHub 最新版本？
scenarios.question_en: Does uninstalling and re-adding the FAF plugin in VS Code UI automatically fetch the latest GitHub commits without manual cache deletion?

scenarios.question_zh: `microsoft/agent-forge` 是否通过 Greenfield/Brownfield Planner + Orchestrator + 7 个 специализированные Writer Agents 生成全部 7 类定制文件？
scenarios.question_en: Does `microsoft/agent-forge` generate all 7 Copilot customization artifact types via Planner + Orchestrator + 7 specialized Writer Agents?

scenarios.question_zh: `detector.ts` 是否支持扫描 14 种技术栈指示文件（`TECH_INDICATORS`）与 14 种项目类型提示文件（`PROJECT_TYPE_HINTS`）？
scenarios.question_en: Does `detector.ts` scan 14 manifest indicator files (`TECH_INDICATORS`) and 14 project-type hint files (`PROJECT_TYPE_HINTS`)?

scenarios.question_zh: `validator.ts` 是否内置 44 个已知 VS Code Copilot 工具名白名单、Levenshtein 距离 `<=3` 拼写建议与跨文件 handoff 名称自动对齐？
scenarios.question_en: Does `validator.ts` enforce 44 known VS Code tool names, Levenshtein distance <=3 typo suggestions, and cross-file handoff auto-fix?

scenarios.question_zh: `merger.ts` 在非 `--force` 模式下是否仅覆盖带有 `<!-- Generated by AGENT-FORGE -->`（或 `SpecForge`）标记的文件并保护用户手写配置？
scenarios.question_en: Does `merger.ts` preserve user-authored `.github/` files and only overwrite files bearing `<!-- Generated by AGENT-FORGE -->` (or `SpecForge`)?

scenarios.question_zh: `microsoft/agent-forge` 生成的 `.github/` 配置是否自带 FAF 的客户立项评分、PRD/C4 架构规范模板、加权加速器目录与 Bicep Landing Zone 部署脚本？
scenarios.question_en: Does `microsoft/agent-forge` ship with FAF's customer PRD/C4 spec templates, weighted accelerator catalogues, or AI Landing Zone Bicep scripts?
scenarios.answer: 0% domain delivery IP bundled (meta-generator vs SDLC practice) ✕
